$comment: forced-reflow-insight is a warning, not a gate. Topic-page layout reads in Toc and ReadTracker are animation-frame batched, and the reflows Lighthouse can attribute to our scripts total under 0.5 ms. The 33-65 ms it still reports on /python/closures/ is [unattributed]: it is the browser's own first full layout of the 1146-object topic page inside AnimationFrame::StyleAndLayout, counted only because the trace engine keeps one global JS-invocation stack across threads and V8 background parser tasks overlap that frame. No source change can remove it.

assertMatrix.$comment: Raised from 61440 on 2026-09-04 with the home page's daily kata. Every UI string lives in one dictionary module that every island-bearing page downloads, so nine `daily.*` keys cost ~300 compressed bytes on pages that never render the card. /python/closures/ was already within ~3 bytes of the old 60 KB line, which left no room for any copy at all; 62 KB restores about 1.7 KB of headroom. The home page itself is 38.6 KB of script.
